CHAT LINT — your PREVIOUS reply broke writing rules that bind chat (5be2f462 banned constructions / 3a9dbafd bare ids / named deal questions / multi-clause task shape / agent-access rationale). It has already reached Joe and cannot be unsent, so do NOT reissue it. Simply avoid these from here on:

  [multi-clause-task] …3. **Stop the six shared jobs on the MacBook, then make the Studio primary.** I can do the…
      fix: say 'all required' with this numbered multi-step instruction

Vocab and contrast-reframe bans are the same ones every client surface already enforces; a bare 8-hex id or 'loop #N' needs its plain-language gloss in the same sentence. Deal questions name their deal; multi-step asks are numbered and marked 'all required'. Agent access is bounded by credentials and autonomous execution, not data confidentiality. Code fences are exempt.
